from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP


def tax(amount, rate):
    """Tax on an invoice amount, to the cent.

    Finance policy FIN-12: round half up to the cent.

    cents = value.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return float(cents)
